frozen_traveler.name: Frozen Traveler
frozen_traveler.description: A traveler shivers beside a lantern. 'Bring me a NOUN before my toes become permanent icicles!'
templates: You offer a {word}. The traveler declares it the latest in thermal fashion and shares a warming sip of soup.
The traveler hugs your {word}. 'Exactly what my grandmother prescribed!' You decide not to ask about her medical qualifications.
Armed with a {word}, the traveler announces that winter has been defeated. Winter declines to comment.

treasure_chest.name: Mysterious Treasure Chest
treasure_chest.description: A chest pokes out of the snow. Describe it with an ADJECTIVE. Its lock has surprisingly strong opinions.
templates: You describe the chest as {word}. Its lock clicks open in reluctant agreement.
'This chest is {word},' you announce. Flattered beyond reason, it opens and tips you for the review.
The {word} chest insists that beauty is on the inside. You agree, especially when the inside contains gold.

icy_portal.name: Mysterious Portal
icy_portal.description: A portal wobbles like enchanted jelly. Enter an ADVERB to describe how you approach it. Results may vary.
templates: You approach the portal {word}. Reality asks whether you have filled out the appropriate form.
You wave {word} at the portal. It waves back, despite having neither hands nor social skills.
You step {word} toward the portal. Somewhere, a wizard drops his sandwich. The portal insists this was intentional.
